natalie_csm: Weekly Aurelia Health check-in — p95/p99 latency for last 7d by route and streaming vs non-streaming. Dropped detailed numbers below, quick callouts: streaming p99 up ~60% on chat route, we've triaged to buffering + long-context sessions. /cc @daniel_sre @maya_cs

maya_cs: thanks — can you paste the numbers and traffic split?

daniel_sre: will review. please include when the spike happened (UTC).

natalie_csm: ```text
Window: 2026-03-13 to 2026-03-19
Traffic: total reqs 1.2M — streaming 28% (mostly chat)

Route                | Mode         | p95   | p99
/v1/chat             | non-stream   | 420ms | 980ms
/v1/chat             | streaming    | 560ms | 1.65s
/v1/generate         | non-stream   | 380ms | 830ms
/v1/generate         | streaming    | 510ms | 1.2s
/v1/embeddings       | non-stream   | 220ms | 430ms
/v1/embeddings       | streaming    | N/A   | N/A (not supported)
```

natalie_csm: Note: streaming p99 spike concentrated 02:00-04:00 UTC on 2026-03-17, correlated with a burst of long-context chat sessions (avg seq len +50%). Error rate stayed ~baseline (~0.6%). Spend: MTD +6% vs baseline (replay/timeouts accounted).

maya_cs: users reported lag at ~02:30 UTC, matches. :thinking_face:

daniel_sre: preliminary triage: head-of-line blocking in streaming buffer when many long sessions open; buffer retention + GC interact poorly with our batching heuristics. I've opened an internal ticket and a patch to enable incremental KV flush + backpressure adjustments.

daniel_sre: ISSUE: INF-4821

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary INF-4821-patch -> prod (canary 2026-03-24 04:00 UTC) :rocket:

elena_pm: What does this mean for the renewal call with Aurelia next week?

natalie_csm: Short answer: UX impact in ~8% of active sessions during the spike window. Recommend proactive outreach + offer a 30-day dedicated throughput burst while patch is validated. Also propose an ops note with config tips: prefer non-streaming for batched completions to avoid tail-latency for long contexts.

maya_cs: I'll draft outreach and a runbook snippet. Assigning action items:
- @maya_cs: customer email + schedule demo/ops call (due 2026-03-20)
- @daniel_sre: finish patch + canary rollout (due 2026-03-24)
- @natalie_csm: prepare slide for renewal call with metrics & mitigation (due 2026-03-21)

natalie_csm: tagging this thread as the canonical health check for Aurelia this week. I'll post canary results and a short follow-up after 03/24. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
